summary: Report failed KV offload transfers to the scheduler instead of asserting that every transfer succeeds
compatibility: No change with the CPU offloading worker, which never fails a transfer. With workers that can fail (the multi-node region mirror), a failed store is dropped and a failed load's blocks are reported as load errors, handled per kv_load_failure_policy.
details: OffloadingWorkerMetadata.failed_jobs reports failed jobs; a job fails if it fails on any worker.
A failed store completes with complete_store(success=False) and drops the KV event metadata recorded for its chunks; a failed load's GPU blocks come back from get_block_ids_with_load_errors.
Failed transfers are not counted in the transfer statistics.
